Headline: #56 Milwaukee Temporary Reroute at Milwaukee/Hubbard
ShortDescription: 56 Milwaukee buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Milwaukee/Hubbard.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#56 Milwaukee buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Milwaukee, Halsted, Hubbard and Milwaukee, over normal route, due to street blockage near Milwaukee/Hubbard.

Allow extra travel time.
